newsitem.title: JAPAN: Deutsche Telekom applies to list shares in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Telekom applies to list shares in Tokyo.

text.p: Deutsche Telekom AG has applied to list its shares on the Tokyo Stock Exchange on November 19, the exchange said on Friday.
A public offering will be held in Japan as part of a global offering of Deutsche Telekom stock of up to a total of 500 million shares, the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) said in a statement.
The company is planning to list its shares on eight German stock exchanges and on the New York Stock Exchange, TSE said.
The public offering in Japan will be held through an auction, although the number of shares to be auctioned in Japan has not yet been decided, the TSE said.
Subscription for the auction for the Tokyo listing would be between October 25 and November 14, the TSE said.
It said the offering price would be set on November 17 and the payment date on November 20.
The offering price would be decided based on demand for the shares on other stock markets, the TSE said.
The company earlier said it plans an initial public offering beginning November 18 in Germany and New York.
